title: SI 2019-197 Supreme Court (Fees) (Civil Cases) (Amendment) Regulations, 2019 (No. 7)
text:
S.I. 197 of 2019
1279
Statutory Instrument 197 of 2019.
[CAP. 7:13
Supreme Court (Fees) (Civil Cases) (Amendment) Regulations, 
2019 (No. 7)
 
IT is hereby notiﬁ ed that the Minister of Justice, Legal and 
Parliamentary Affairs, in terms of section 35 of the Supreme Court 
Act [Chapter 7:13], has made the following regulations:—
 
1. These regulations may be cited as the Supreme Court (Fees) 
(Civil Cases) (Amendment) Regulations, 2019 (No. 7).
 
2. The Supreme Court (Fees) (Civil Cases) Regulations, 1992, 
published in Statutory Instrument 425 of 1992, are amended by the 
repeal of the Schedule and the substitution of—
“SCHEDULE (Section 2)
FEES
 
Z$
 1. 
Appeal from lower court . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 30,00
 
 2. 
Application for condonation or extension of time or 
 
 
 reinstatement . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 30,00
 
 3. 
Order of court or certiﬁ ed copy thereof . . . . . . . . . . 10,00
 
 4. 
Certiﬁ cate by the Registrar . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 30,00
 
 5. 
Afﬁ xing the seal of the Court to any document—
 
 
(General charge) . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 30,00
 
(a) notice of taxation . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 80,00
 
(b) application for set down for taxation . . . . . . . . . 80,00
 6. 
Making a copy of any document, other than a certiﬁ ed copy of an 
 
 
order of the court—
 
(a) by photocopying means, per page . . . . . . . . . . 
2,00
 
(b) by original typing, per page . . . . . . . . . . . . . 
5,00
 
(c) by duplicated or printed copy, per page . . . . . . . . 
2,00
 7. 
Supplying transcript of shorthand notes, per typed page—
 
(a) for the ﬁ rst copy requested by any party . . . . . . . . 
5,00
 
(b) for the second and each subsequent copy made at the same 
 
 
time and supplied to the same party that requested the ﬁ rst 
 
 
copy . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 
5,00
 8. 
Search fee . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .  5,00
 
 9. 
Retrieving ﬁ le from archives . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 10,00”. 

1280
Supreme Court (Fees) (Civil Cases) (Amendment) Regulations, 
2019 (No. 7)
Supplement to the Zimbabwean Government Gazette dated the 13th September, 2019. 
Printed by the Government Printer, Harare.
 
3. The Supreme Court (Fees) (Civil Cases) (Amendment) 
Regulations, 2009 (No. 5), published in Statutory Instrument 152 
of 2009, and the Supreme Court (Fees) (Civil Cases) (Amendment) 
Regulations, 2016 (No. 6), published in Statutory Instrument 49 of 
2016, are repealed.
